title: HoldCam
description: Provides keybindings for 3rd person view while holding.
body:
# HoldCam
This mod provides these two simple keybindings.

- Rear Camera (Default: R key): Hold to get 3rd person **back** camera (The perspective when you press F5 **once**)
- Front Camera (Default: G key): Hold to get 3rd person **front** camera (The perspective when you press F5 **twice**)

When you release the key, it will return to the normal (first person) perspective.
